scope: Six offline reports of six existing 3M tail4 runs among the 36 executions already reported in 4023/4024. Zero new executions.

contract.causality: exposure demonstrates temporal/resource overlap only, not delay caused or production fidelity
contract.executing: start_ns <= t < finish_ns; callback wall occupancy, not on-CPU or runnable
contract.interval: union within each new-request/resource; sum across these pairs, never sum old/new task pairs
contract.inverse_comparison: exposed/nonexposed means include each callback full wait, not only covered time; longer waits have more chance to overlap, so this comparison is descriptive and length-biased
contract.inverse_denominator: all cohort later-wave operators, including zero-wait callbacks in the nonexposed group; callback-ms sums covered unions per callback
contract.inverse_wait: each cohort later-wave callback [submitted,start) intersected with the union of strictly newer requests stage0 executing intervals; newer candidates include requests outside the cohort
contract.new: completed planned-arrival cohort, first-wave stage0 only, all late records retained
contract.numa: same NUMA includes different clusters and does not establish shared-CPU contention
contract.old: strictly earlier planned arrival; equal planned timestamps are not ordered by ID
contract.other: all requests contribute later-wave operators, including requests outside the cohort
contract.pending: post-routing submitted_ns <= t < start_ns; not exact Folly queue occupancy
contract.simultaneous: new stage0 executing and at least one strictly older later-wave operator executing
contract.submission: query at post-routing submitted_ns using chosen destination, not pre-choice pressure

resource.attribution: chosen pool maps to its declared CPU set; hardware cluster identity is not independently verified

limitations: Only the supplied terminal report is available locally. Target requests.csv, tasks.csv and summary.json hashes are recorded, not independently recomputed here.
Executing is callback wall occupancy; pending is post-routing submitted-not-started. Neither measures CPU service, kernel runnable demand or exact Folly queue occupancy.
Overlap establishes shared time and declared pool resources, not causal slowdown. Conditional exposed/nonexposed full-wait means are length-biased.
Pool and NUMA executing-union durations have different resource multiplicities and cannot be compared as CPU utilization.
Later-wave wait includes 768 later-wave stage0 and 16128 ordinary-successor callbacks per run. It is not the ordinary-successor-only mean.
Latency and overlap use 192 planned arrivals in [2,18) seconds; process CPU uses all 240 completed requests.
Two seeds are descriptive; no confidence interval or average of p99 is inferred. The 80x1 + 4x22 graph is an uncalibrated sensitivity model.
The 128/192 exposure frequency depends on regular 12 QPS and round-robin home ordering; it is not a production probability.
Declared CPU sets are disjoint, but hardware cluster identity is not independently verified by this analysis.
No new pressure time series, production request markers, gate experiment or threshold validation is supplied.
